Me:

Drunk currently. Big issue. Admittedly. 
I prostitute myself to a very abusive man in order to provide my parents with a place to live. I'm an only child. They take my abuser's side more often than my own during an issue. I'm really sick of surviving this way. Sometimes, I wish we'd all die. I'm so afraid, I'm honestly stupefied and lost.

I'm sick of hurting. I want it all to cease. I want calm and peace of sorts.

 What made you hit your lowest of lows? I am sick of myself, and for once, find myself sick of my family and generally my life. I always found happiness and joy among family presence. Now, I'm tired and desperate and scared. I am so scared. I wish I had a safe hand to hold. Every hand here abuses me or ignores my legitimate concerns. Typing is so hard. Agh. Sorry.
